verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises large-codebase querying and a 1M-token context window that one user found lets it 'navigate and learn' huge codebases effortlessly (gemini-cli-comm-1, gemini-cli-gh-1), but other developers report it is 'stupid at navigation in the codebase' and 10x slower than alternatives, gets stuck in spaghetti code, and ignores its own GEMINI.md context files meant to orient it (gemini-cli-comm-13, gemini-cli-comm-14, gemini-cli-comm-15).
